gui_forms::ToolTip.summary: ToolTip is a nonvisual window-bound provider that tokenizes help text to live controls and coordinates hover/focus/manual presentation through one scheduler-backed state machine. It owns delayed show, reshow, auto-pop, movement tracking, popup revocation, input-transparent overlay composition, configurable maximum width, and exact visibility events.
remarks: Maps help text to live controls through tokenized `set_tool_tip`, lookup, removal, and clear operations.
Initial, reshow, and auto-pop delays, hover/focus enablement, and `show_always` are retained policies; explicit persistent or duration-bounded show and immediate hide are available.
Presentation is an input-transparent overlay-plane popup anchored to the target or the pointer and repositioned live when the owner moves; a stable semantic `tool_tip` node is published.
Popup and timer cleanup is synchronous when a mapping, target, provider, or Window goes away. Accessible described-by relations and title/icon/balloon variants remain open.
gui_forms::ToolTip.ownership: A nonvisual `Component`. The application owns it directly or through a `ComponentContainer`; it binds to one live Window and never becomes part of the visual tree. Disposal is synchronous and idempotent and revokes every outstanding callback before teardown.
gui_forms::ToolTip.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::ToolTip.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
